data.name: Suggested Attribute Checks
table: Moving silently, hiding and acting unnoticed.
Avoiding a trap or finding a way to flee a collapsing building.
Anticipating someone's movements and catching them by surprise.
Completing a work of craftsmanship or repairing something.
Moving gracefully to earn someone's attention.
Examining or investigating someone or something.
Getting information from someone during a conversation.
Persuading someone through authority or diplomacy.
Hard work, such as lifting a portcullis or pushing a statue.

data.name: Difficulty Levels
table: Who is likely to accomplish this?
Anyone with a bit of training or natural talent.
A competent person, or a very talented one.
Someone who is among the very best in that field.

data.name: Opportunities
table: The next Check performed by you or an ally will receive a +4 bonus.
A creature suffers dazed, shaken, slow or weak.
You create a Bond towards someone or something or add an emotion to one of your existing Bonds.
Choose a creature present in the scene: they make a compromising statement chosen by the person who controls them.
Your Actions earn you someone's support or admiration.
You spot a useful clue or detail. The GM may tell you what it is or ask you to introduce that detail yourself.
An item is destroyed, lost, stolen, or left behind.
You may fill or erase up to two section on a Clock.
Someone or something of your choice suddenly appears in the scene.
You discover one Vulnerability or one Trait of a creature you can see.
You learn the goals and motivations of a creature of your choice.
